title: Sr. Graphic Designer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Avantor is looking for a Senior Graphic Designer is a key member of Molecule Creative Services, Avantor’s in\-house agency, responsible for designing, developing, and executing high\-quality creative deliverables across print, digital, and presentation formats. This role requires a deep understanding of brand systems, marketing applications, and production design — from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 The Senior Graphic Designer works closely with the Production Manager, Creative Managers and designers, and integrated marketing teams to ensure brand consistency, creative excellence, and on\-time execution across a wide range of Avantor marketing materials.
   

  

 You bring a strong foundation in design craft, a passion for visual storytelling, and an eye for detail. You're equally comfortable working within established brand guidelines and extending them across new applications.
   

  

 Reporting to the Production Design Manager, you will also provide creative guidance to junior designers and serve as a dependable partner to cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  

* Apply Avantor brand identity systems across print, digital, presentation, packaging, and sales enablement materials.
* Design, adapt, and finalize creative deliverables using templates, brand guidelines, and creative direction.
* Develop best\-in\-class creative from brief to completion, supporting campaigns across business segments and channels.
* Create polished PowerPoint presentations for sales, training, corporate events, leadership reports, and high\-value programs.
* Ensure all deliverables meet brand, quality, accessibility, file\-format, version\-control, and production standards.
* Understand digital, print, motion, video, and omni\-channel production requirements.
* Tailor materials for customer segments, industries, regional markets, and distribution channels.
* Collaborate with creative, production, marketing, and cross\-functional teams to execute projects efficiently.
* Communicate design rationale, constraints, file formats, and best practices clearly to stakeholders.
* Provide creative guidance and mentorship to junior designers.
* Manage multiple projects under tight timelines with strong organization, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Maintain organized project folders, templates, content libraries, and archived assets for future use.


**Requirements**
 Mastery of Adobe Creative Suite — InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat.
   

  

* Expert\-level Microsoft PowerPoint skills including slide design, animation, and complex formatting.
* Strong understanding of print production processes, file formats (PDF/X, bleed, color profiles), and digital publishing best practices.
* Experience with social media asset creation across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, web banners).
* HTML and banner animation experience a plus.
* Common space, event, and spatial design experience preferred.
* Comfortable with Workfront or similar project management and proofing platforms.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, communication design, visual arts, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* 5\+ years of industry or agency experience, including work with multi\-channel and international brands.
* Strong design portfolio demonstrating range across print, digital, and presentation formats.
* Background in healthcare, life sciences, biopharmaceutical, or B2B marketing preferred.
* Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mainly sedentary.
* Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past assignments are used to resolve work problems and plan for expected safety requirements.
* Frequent volume of work and deadlines may impose strain on a routine basis.
* Global coverage and flexibility of shift coverage.


**Disclaimer**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Why Avantor?**
**Dare to go further in your career.** 
 Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.
   

  

**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** 
 It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
   

  

 We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world.
 **Apply today!**
**EEO Statement**
 We are an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/province, or local law.
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at recruiting@avantorsciences.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

Please click here for our Privacy Policy which explains the purposes for which we will use your personal information and the ways in which we will handle and retain your information. title: Designer - Civil & Structural
description:
Designer \- Civil \& Structural Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 9/24/26 Engineering
   

  

 Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end\-to\-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission\-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
   

  

 Discover us at gradiant.com.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* To carry out structural drawings for water and wastewater facilities (i.e. Skids / modules, pipe supports, pipe racks etc.,)
* Prepare basic 2D drawings and 3D CAD models as per given guidelines and standards such as General arrangement (GA) drawings, Steel structure drawings, Foundation drawings, Pipe rack and equipment support drawings
* Interpret and convert engineering designs into precise technical drawings
* Support preparation of manufacturing drawings and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* To prepare drawings and organize design reviews.
* Review project specifications, manufacturer submittals, local standards and codes
* Prepare drawings for permits and construction.
* Coordinate requirements with other disciplines for input collection.


**Requirements**
* Diploma / ITI / Bachelors in Civil or Structural Engineering
* 3 – 5years of experience in water and wastewater facilities / power / oil \& gas / industrial projects
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD (2D mandatory; 3D is a plus)
* Proficient with AutoCAD is mandatory.

title: Designer - Facades - Cad & Structural
description:
Role Overview
 



 We are seeking a competent Facade Structural Designer to join our Coimbatore design office. The role involves the structural design, analysis, and engineering of façade systems for premium commercial and infrastructure projects.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 \- Structural design and analysis of unitized, semi\-unitized, stick, spider glazing, and bespoke façade systems.
 



 \- Design of glass, aluminum, steel members, brackets, anchors, and connections as per applicable codes.
 



 \- Preparation and review of structural calculations, GA drawings, and fabrication/shop drawings.
 



 \- Perform wind load, seismic load, thermal and deflection analysis for façade elements.
 



 \- Coordinate with architects, consultants, production, and site teams.
 



 \- Support value engineering and cost optimization.
 



 \- Provide technical guidance during fabrication and site installation.
 



 \- Ensure compliance with quality standards, safety norms, and project specifications.
 



 \- Participate in client, consultant, and internal review meetings.
 



 Qualification \& Experience
 



 \- B.E / B.Tech or M.E / M.Tech in Civil / Structural Engineering.
 



 \- Minimum 4\+ years of relevant façade structural design experience.
 



 \- Strong working knowledge of façade systems and materials.
 



 \- Proficiency in AutoCAD (mandatory), Revit (preferred).
 



 \- Working knowledge of STAAD, ETABS, SAP2000 or equivalent software.
 



 \- Knowledge of IS, ASTM, BS/EN codes related to façade and structural design.
 



 Key Skills
 



 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



 \- High attention to detail
 



 \- Good communication and coordination abilities
 



 \- Ability to handle multiple projects under deadlines
 



 \- Exposure to performance testing and mock\-ups is an advantage
 



 What VS Craft Offers
 



 \- Opportunity to work on prestigious façade and building envelope projects
 



 \- Strong technical learning and career growth
 



 \- Competitive compensation
 



 \- Professional and collaborative work environment
 



 Job Type: Full\-time
 



 Interested \- Kindly send you CV to hr@vs\-craft.in

 ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

* Ensure drawings adhere to industry standards, project specifications, and quality requirements.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Job type: Full time (Onsite)** 




**Experience: 3\-5 years** 




  





**Roles \& responsibilities** 




 A Senior Graphic Designer is a skilled professional responsible for leading and executing the visual design of various projects, ensuring they align with brand guidelines, convey the desired message, and meet high standards of quality. This role typically involves both creative leadership and hands\-on design work. Here are the key roles and responsibilities typically associated with a Senior Graphic Designer
 



  





**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Creative Direction and Strategy** 




**Visual Conceptualization:** 
 Develop and execute creative concepts and visual designs that align with project objectives and brand identity.
 



**Design Strategy:** 
 Collaborate with stakeholders to develop design strategies that support marketing, communication, and business goals.
 



  





**2\. Design Execution** 




**Graphic Design:** 
 Create compelling visual materials, including but not limited to logos, marketing collateral, brochures, infographics, digital and print advertisements, social media assets, and presentations.
 



**Typography and Layout:** 
 Ensure effective use of typography, layout, and color theory to enhance visual appeal and readability.
 



  





**3\. Project Management** 




**Project Oversight:** 
 Manage multiple projects from concept through completion, ensuring deadlines and budget constraints are met.
 



**Client Interaction:** 
 Communicate with clients to understand their requirements, present design concepts, and incorporate feedback to achieve client satisfaction.
 



  





**4\. Team Leadership and Collaboration** 




**Team Management:** 
 Lead and mentor junior designers, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.
 



**Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with copywriters, marketers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive and integrated design solutions.
 



  





**5\. Quality Assurance** 




**Design Standards:** 
 Maintain and enforce brand and design standards across all projects, ensuring consistency and quality.
 



**Review and Feedback:** 
 Conduct design reviews, provide constructive feedback, and approve final designs before delivery.
 



  





**6\. Creative Innovation and Trends** 




**Industry Trends:** 
 Stay informed about current design trends, techniques, tools, and best practices to innovate and enhance design output.
 



**Innovation:** 
 Introduce new ideas and creative solutions to elevate the visual impact and effectiveness of design deliverables.
 



  





**7\. Technical Skills and Tools** 




**Design Software Proficiency:** 
 Expert proficiency in graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Sketch, Figma, or other relevant tools.
 



**Print and Digital Expertise:** 
 Familiarity with both print and digital design processes, including knowledge of file formats, color management, and printing techniques.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




**Design Expertise:** 
 Extensive experience in graphic design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design projects and styles.
 



**Leadership Skills:** 
 Proven ability to lead and inspire a design team, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 



**Project Management:** 
 Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple deadlines.
 



**Creativity:** 
 Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with a keen eye for detail and aesthetics.
 



**Problem\-Solving:** 
 Ability to solve design challenges effectively and adapt designs to meet changing project requirements.
 



**Client Management:** 
 Experience in client\-facing roles, with the ability to understand client needs and deliver solutions that exceed expectations.

Piping Designer, Asset Design Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 9/7/26 Engineering
   

  

 Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end\-to\-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission\-critical operations in the world's essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy.
   

  

 Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
   

  

 Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Piping Designer to join our Mobile / Containerized Design team. The ideal candidate will have 3\+years of relevant experience, preferably in water treatment containerized design and new asset design engineering. This role requires strong engineering expertise, including the ability to review documents and drawings produced by the Gradiant Global Engineering Center in India and/or outsourced engineering consultants. Piping Designer will do Asset design and implement the asset design process, tools, best practices, safety reviews and team training / mentoring.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Must be capable of providing conceptual as well as detailed design drawings of water treatment plant piping.
* Requires experience with specification of piping, piping components valves, instruments, vessels, and other mechanical equipment.
* Creating Piping Routing in AutoCAD Plant 3D with respect to Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) and optimizing the Skids \& Plant piping.
* Develop 3D Models and ensure clash\-free models in coordination with all other discipline requirements.
* Preparation of Equipment layout, Skid piping GA, 2D piping layout, Isometrics, MTOs, pipe support drawings, Pipe rack design input, and Civil and vendor drawing reviews.
* Should have experience with piping design standards with ANSI/IS/ASME piping specifications and layouts for water treatment plants. Must be familiar with relevant design \& ASME, IS, DIN, and BS codes.
* Confirm compliance with customer specifications for equipment and material types.
* Review and approve 3D model, drawings and documents from 3rd party design companies.
* Good communication skills in the English language with the ability to effectively communicate in both verbal and written correspondence are essential.
* Coordination with inter discipline, Vendor and clients
* Ensuring engineering and design quality, technical accuracy of drawings, material quantities etc.
* Collaborate with Engineering manager to plan and execute projects on time and on budgeted manhours.
* Participate in project meetings, design reviews, and progress assessments to ensure project objectives are met.
* Quality Control and Compliance: Ensure that all piping designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices. Conduct quality control reviews to verify design integrity and safety.
* Contributes as a team member in the development of projects carrying out assigned responsibilities in a timely, diligent, safe and professional manner
* Familiar with Gradiant’s new technologies, engineering design of Skids / modules, pipe supports, pipe racks.
* Collaborate with QA/QC, and Manufacturing.
* support the internal and external design reviews, safety and HAZOP reviews and maintain the document controls

title: Senior Hardware Designer
description:
* X\+ years of experience in Hardware Design and Product Development for automotive, industrial, or embedded electronic systems.

title: Creative Lead
company: Dtech Information Technology and Outsourcing Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description** 




 Dtech Information Technology and Outsourcing Pvt Ltd is part of Delight Investment Group (DIG) which is a diversified group with operations spanning facility management, logistics, oil field supplies, and IT. Our in\-house Design \& Creative team supports every part of the business, from brand and campaign work to internal communications and recruitment collateral, giving designers exposure to a wide range of industries and problems rather than a single account or product.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We're looking for a Creative Lead to head our in\-house design function, owning creative direction, leading a small design team, and delivering branding, campaign, and communication assets across a diversified group with multiple business lines. You'll move between big\-picture brand strategy and hands\-on execution in the same week, and you'll see your work used across very different contexts, from a hiring campaign to a client\-facing tender document. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can both direct a team and roll up their sleeves.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




 • Lead and manage an in\-house design team, allocating work and reviewing output for quality and consistency
 



 • Translate business briefs from different teams into clear creative concepts and campaign directions
 



 • Own creative execution across digital, social media, branding, and internal/external collateral
 



 • Present creative work to internal stakeholders, explain your thinking, and incorporate feedback
 



 • Maintain and evolve brand guidelines so they hold up consistently across multiple business lines
 



 • Plan and prioritise creative requests across several teams and deadlines simultaneously
 



 • Provide hands\-on design support (layout, typography, image treatment) when timelines require direct execution rather than delegation
 



 • Mentor and develop design team members, giving regular, constructive feedback
 



 • Keep an eye on design trends, AI\-assisted creative tools, and production techniques, and bring relevant ones into the team's workflow
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field
 



 • 4–7 years of creative/design experience, including 1–2 years leading or mentoring designers
 



 • Strong conceptual thinking, able to take a brief from idea to a finished, on\-brand asset
 



 • Hands\-on proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign
 



 • Working proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects, with hands\-on experience editing social media reels, short\-form videos, and basic motion graphics
 



 • Comfortable managing multiple projects at once and presenting confidently to non\-design stakeholders
 



 • Agency or multi\-brand in\-house experience preferred.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 • A role with real creative ownership: you'll shape how a multi\-vertical group presents itself, not just execute a single brand playbook
 



 • Variety: campaign, brand, recruitment, and corporate communication work across very different industries
 



 • A small, close\-knit team where your leadership and mentorship directly shape how the function grows.
